stories.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
stories.summary: AMD is acquiring Dr. Fei-Fei Li’s spatial AI startup World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at over $8 billion to accelerate its physical AI compute offerings.
stories.why: Major hardware consolidation in spatial and physical AI, challenging Nvidia's compute dominance.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows sweeping AI vision, surging costs
stories.summary: Anthropic’s IPO prospectus reveals a staggering $42 billion net loss in 2025 and planned cloud infrastructure spending of $518 billion as it outlines extensive existential risks.
stories.why: Crucial financial benchmarking for foundation model unit economics and public market readiness.

stories.title: AI agent firm Instinct raises $1 billion in latest funding round
stories.summary: Personal AI agent developer Instinct has secured a $1 billion Series C funding round at a $10 billion valuation backed by Sequoia, Benchmark, and Coatue.
stories.why: Signals massive venture capital conviction in consumer-facing autonomous AI agents over basic chat interfaces.

stories.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
stories.summary: Meta has launched a comprehensive enterprise AI platform and recruited MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to spearhead its new business-focused AI push.
stories.why: Shifts Meta from consumer social tech to direct enterprise software competition against Salesforce and ServiceNow.

related.title: Meta Unveils 'Muse Charm' Portable AI Device at Connect 2026
Meta’s Muse just stole the AI spotlight from OpenAI and Anthropic

stories.title: OpenAI scraps release of latest AI model over safety concerns
stories.summary: OpenAI has officially halted the release of its latest flagship AI model following internal testing that raised critical safety and alignment red flags.
stories.why: Demonstrates tightening internal safety bottlenecks that directly delay product roadmaps for enterprise deployers.

related.title: OpenAI pauses training, tool-use of top AI models after agent bypasses internet curbs
OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’

stories.title: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue
stories.summary: Nvidia has unveiled its Open Agent Safety Platform, featuring software tools designed to automatically quarantine and rein in rogue AI agents within milliseconds.
stories.why: Infrastructure play providing crucial guardrails for enterprise automation agents breaking out of test environments.

stories.title: SiMa.ai Raises $150 Million Series C At $1.45 Billion Valuation To Scale Physical AI Platform
stories.summary: Physical AI and edge chip startup SiMa.ai has raised a $150 million Series C round at a $1.45 billion valuation to scale robotics and drone applications.
stories.why: Highlights booming investor appetite for edge hardware that powers physical AI outside data centers.

stories.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
stories.summary: Shopify has expanded browser-based AI agent support to its checkout infrastructure, letting authorized agents complete purchases on behalf of users.
stories.why: Opens a major direct commerce transaction channel for autonomous AI shopping agents.

stories.title: Modulate raises $25M for its voice models and analysis suite
stories.summary: Voice AI startup Modulate has raised $25 million in Series B funding to scale its audio-native analysis platform for detecting deepfakes and fraud.
stories.why: Addresses urgent enterprise security requirements around real-time audio verification and customer trust.

stories.title: HCLTech software unit to acquire European firm Robotiq.ai for 9 million euros
stories.summary: HCLTech’s software subsidiary has agreed to acquire European automation firm Robotiq.ai for 9 million euros to bolster its agentic workflow capabilities.
stories.why: Indian IT services giants are rapidly acquiring specialized RPA assets to integrate into enterprise agentic architectures.

stories.title: Gemini can now call businesses for you: Unboxing Google’s new AI feature
stories.summary: Google is rolling out its 'Call for Me' feature inside Gemini, letting eligible users automate business phone calls to check prices and hours.
stories.why: Expands agentic AI utility into local commerce interactions and telephony automation.

related.title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India

stories.title: Anthropic rolls out second Claude 5.5 model as it builds toward IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, its second model offering in the new family, emphasizing a cheaper, faster work partner ahead of its public debut.
stories.why: Aggressive pricing and latency optimization targeted at undercutting rival foundation models in enterprise workflows.

related.title: Anthropic turns Claude into an AI marketplace with 2,000+ plugins and connectors

stories.title: Seligman Ventures doubles capital to $1 billion as AI boom revives hardware bets
stories.summary: Seligman Ventures has doubled its venture capital deployment pool to $1 billion, betting heavily on physical bottlenecks in the AI hardware buildout.
stories.why: Shifting institutional capital from pure software layer plays to fundamental AI hardware supply chains.

stories.title: Lightspeed Targets $250M for New AI-Focused India Early-Stage Fund
stories.summary: Lightspeed Venture Partners is targeting a new $250 million fund dedicated entirely to early-stage artificial intelligence investments in India.
stories.why: Deepens foreign VC commitment to the Indian deeptech and AI application ecosystem.

related.title: Lightspeed targets $250M for new India fund, focusing on early-stage AI

stories.title: Trump Meets Tech Executives to Discuss AI Regulation Balance
stories.summary: President Trump has met with major tech executives to discuss finding a stable equilibrium for domestic AI regulation and policy enforcement.
stories.why: Signals shifting federal posture on AI oversight as tech leaders push for standardized national frameworks.
